# Collateral Management Policy
We take collateral for loans and trades. People should check the things and make sure they look good. Sometimes we ask legal if it's okay. Most of the time it's fine.
We mostly do bonds and stocks but sometimes other things. If something is risky then maybe apply a
discount. The desk decides what works. There is no need to write everything down because people
know what to do.
### 3.1 General Principles
All collateral assets must be properly reviewed, valued, and approved before acceptance. Collateral discounts may be applied based on the risk profile of the asset. Exceptions to this policy must be documented and approved by the Collateral Management Committee.

### 4.1 Management Responsibilities
The Collateral Management Committee is responsible for overseeing the collateral management process, including setting policies, approving exceptions, and monitoring compliance. Front office teams are responsible for initiating and managing collateral transactions, while risk and legal teams provide support and oversight.

### 5.1 Implementation Procedures
Detailed procedures for collateral onboarding, valuation, and monitoring will be maintained by the Collateral Management team. Reporting on collateral activities will be provided to management on a monthly basis.
### 6.1 Compliance Requirements
All employees must comply with this Collateral Management Policy. Violations may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

### 7.1 Review Frequency
This policy will be reviewed and updated annually by the Collateral Management Committee to ensure it remains current and effective.
